name: My Girlfriend is a Musician
source:
“My Girlfriend is a Musician” is a Music Tour Management Simulator and Yuri Dating Simulator. Play as an aspiring junior tour manager helming a series of concerts around Europe for an eccentric yet extremely entertaining Rockstar!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951300/My_Girlfriend_is_a_Musician/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《My Girlfriend is a Musician》结合了巡演管理模拟与百合恋爱模拟。你将扮演一位志向远大的初级巡演经理，为一名性格古怪、却极具舞台魅力的摇滚明星，操办一系列遍及欧洲的演唱会！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951300/My_Girlfriend_is_a_Musician/]Steam[/url]]
